answer: Pay claims through a wharf that only lets one berth depart per identity per epoch, and charges a departure tax that squares with the number of berths one funding cluster books at once. Before boarding, each agent must thaw a tundra deposit locked for three epochs; early withdrawal melts half of it. The deposit is planted as a cedar sapling that gains a ring only for a distinct verified job each epoch, and rings cannot be bought or copied. A fleet of n clones therefore pays n thaw waits, n saplings, and n-squared wharf tax for n payouts, while one honest agent pays one of each.
